The studio

Good gardens begin
with paying attention.

To the way light moves. To what already grows. To the people who will call the garden their own.

A small, independent studio

Thoughtful by nature.
Practical by design.

Fieldwork is a garden design studio led by Eleanor Reed, based in Bath and working across Somerset. We design for people who want to spend more time outside, whether that means growing things, sharing food or simply finding a quiet corner.

Our approach is grounded in the place itself. We look for materials that sit comfortably with the house, plants that suit the conditions and layouts that make everyday use feel easy.

You work directly with the designer from the first conversation to the final plan. We keep the process clear and give you time to make decisions.

Start a conversation
Our approach

Made for life outside.

01 / LISTEN

First, your everyday life.

We talk about how you use the garden, what you love and what isn’t working. No need to arrive with a finished brief.

02 / DESIGN

A plan with a purpose.

We explore layouts, materials and planting, then refine a clear direction together. You’ll know what comes next.

03 / GROW

Good things take root.

We help turn the design into a garden and leave you with practical guidance to care for it as it grows.

A garden is never quite finished.

That is part of its appeal. We design with growth in mind: trees that will bring shade, planting that can settle into its space and materials that age well.

Practical care matters just as much as the first photograph. Every planting plan comes with notes to help you look after it, season by season.

Fieldwork and Eleanor Reed are fictional, created for this portfolio project.

A good garden starts with a conversation.

Tell us what you have in mind. We’ll work out the next step together.
